title: Gay voice
html_source: While Joyce meant ‘gay’ in the original meaning of being light-hearted and/or carefree, in the context of the contrast between Mulligan’s jesting nature and Dedalus' later revealed exasperation at Haines' presence at the tower makes the description of his voice as ‘gay’ to be irritating, or overly facetious.
